content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"a user","i_want":"update the details of an existing task","so_that":"my task details stay accurate after I create them","business_description":"Users can change an existing task's title, due date and other editable details through the same form used to create a task. The backend validates each save, and the frontend shows only the result the backend confirms.","business_value":"Users can correct task details after creation without deleting and recreating the task.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user changes the title and clicks save","then":"The backend stores the new title, the task list shows the new title, and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user clears the title field and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the title is required, and the stored title is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task with a creation date of 1 March","when":"The user sets the due date to 28 February and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the due date cannot be earlier than the creation date, and the stored due date is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form and the backend returns an error for the save request","when":"The user clicks save","then":"The task list shows the previous values of the task, an error message is displayed, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task that no longer exists and is open in the edit form","when":"The user saves changes to it","then":"The backend responds with a task not found error, the form shows an error message, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A save request that sends a field value the backend does not accept","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error, stores no changes, and returns the error to the frontend"},{"given":"An update request that omits the title","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and stores no changes"},{"given":"A save request that fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"The backend returns the error","then":"The backend stores no partial changes and the frontend shows an error message"}],"edge_cases":["Saving changes to a task that no longer exists returns a task not found error and no changes are stored.","A due date equal to the creation date is not earlier than the creation date and is accepted.","The frontend does not show a success state while the save request is pending or after it has failed.","The specification does not state whether the creation date can be changed in edit mode; this is an open question."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} updates the title, description and due date of an existing task and returns the updated task.","A save with an date is unchanged.","Task not found, invalid input, missing mandatory field and internal server or database errors return the agreed simple error responses.","The edit form is pre-filled with the stored values of the task.","A success message appears only after the backend confirms the update, and an error message appears after a failed update.","The task list does not show changed values for
